Boss-damage heavy weapon appropriate to the encounter

builds.name: Solar Team Cure
builds.summary: A Solar Hunter concept using the reworked Wormhusk Crown to turn dodge into a stronger personal and nearby-ally cure tool while Burning Souls supports Solar ability damage.

exoticArmor.name: Wormhusk Crown
exoticArmor.reason: Update 9.7.0 reworked Wormhusk so class ability grants cure, Solar multikills grant Burning Souls, and dodging while active greatly cures the player and nearby allies.

armor3.setBonusNotes: Set bonus intentionally open until current owned sets and exact perk text are reviewed.

subclassSetup.notes: The core Solar identity is practical, but the complete fragment set requires current in-game confirmation.

mods.notes: Exact current mod names, costs and stacking behavior require human confirmation.

artifact.notes: No Artifact perk is treated as mandatory for this static build seed.

requirements: Solar weapon capable of reliable multikills
Champion-capable weapon frame appropriate to the activity

gameplayLoop: Use Solar weapon multikills to build Burning Souls.
Dodge while Burning Souls is active when the team needs a strong cure pulse.
Use Healing Grenade and Solar abilities to stabilize difficult rooms.
reviewNotes: Confirm stat targets against owned Armor 3.0 pieces

builds.name: Solar Ignition Engine

exoticArmor.name: Hallowfire Heart
exoticArmor.reason: Current Monument of Triumph build research identifies the reworked Sunfire Furnace loop as the core of the Exotic's Solar ability package.
